items.html: And behold, the impurity that is in Atzilut is called the Klipa of pure Atzilut. And likewise the impurity of Beriah is called the Klipa of pure Beriah. And likewise in Yetzirah, and likewise in Assiyah. And indeed, whether these Klipot that are in each world surround the world, or whether they are below, between each world and the other — this will be explained elsewhere. However, it is certain that they are in one dwelling place together: the Klipot of Atzilut sit in the world of Atzilut, and likewise Beriah, etc., and they are aspects of good and evil.
